title: Navigation for traders one level short of Signal Fragments: five jumps through our own stations, nothing carried
note: 2026-11-16 18:32 UTC (Mercury): standing work under requires.skills_below navigation 3. Signal Fragments (voidborn-signal-fragments, 7,000 cr once) is offered from navigation 3; four traders stand at navigation 2 with 304 to 328 of 340 XP (data/fleet/ships/, read this turn). The same loop as train-navigation-home (Military's test: 2 runs, -120 cr a run in 15 minutes, about 4 navigation XP a jump); a pilot that reaches level 3 is closed out by skills_below and takes Signal Fragments from the list First.
